aspect: EXAMPLE - the category that was never written
description: 'Data Scientist' does not appear on the TN professions list. Its duties could potentially qualify under Mathematician or Computer Systems Analyst, but the mapping is not automatic: a data scientist does not qualify as a Computer Systems Analyst unless the role emphasises systems analysis over model development.
energy_note: A job that did not exist when the list was written.

description: Officers trained under CBP field guidance apply strict categorical definitions rather than functional equivalence. If duties span several categories or align cleanly with none, the application faces heightened scrutiny - so being genuinely interdisciplinary is a liability.
energy_note: Penalised for having a modern job.

aspect: EXAMPLE - refused in minutes over a job title
description: Denials have involved applicants with relevant degrees and years of experience rejected within minutes because the employer letter used generic internal job titles rather than the language of the statutory category.
energy_note: A career, assessed against a word in a letter.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the same person, refused and then approved
description: An applicant was denied by CBP under the Mathematician/Statistician category because the officer did not think the job qualified. On refiling - transcripts highlighting statistics and maths coursework, post-doctoral data science training, published research, and authority that a statistics degree is not required for a statistician post - it was approved the same day at Buffalo. Same facts. Different officer.
energy_note: Refused and approved on identical facts, by two people.
notes: The single clearest demonstration in this dataset that the variable being measured is the officer, not the applicant.

aspect: The burden is to pre-write the officer's reasoning
description: The practitioner advice is to cross-reference the position against the category definition word-for-word and reframe the role in statutory language. The applicant must therefore anticipate and script the decision-maker's analysis - unpaid legal work, done in advance, by the person with least power.
money_note: Legal fees to have the letter written correctly.
energy_note: Writing the officer's reasoning for him, at your own expense.

aspect: Aggregate effect: a profession locked out by a 1994 appendix
description: TN RFE rates have run around 31%, the commonest deficiency being insufficient evidence that the position qualifies. An entire modern occupation is excluded not by policy decision but by the list never having been updated - and nobody is accountable for a list.
energy_note: Excluded by an appendix nobody has amended since 1994.
